figurative_meaning_en: How long? / For how much time? / Up to what limit?
example_sentences_in_bangla: কাঁহাতক এই অন্যায় সহ্য করা যায়?
example_sentences_in_english: How long can one tolerate this injustice?
How much longer will this situation continue?
note: This idiom is derived from archaic Bengali questioning forms, commonly used in spoken language to express impatience or seek boundaries.
